svg.title: Figure 10-1. The item boundary in the safety view (WP-C-04 §2, §5, §9, §10)
svg.desc: The item boundary of WP-C-01 Figure 3-2 with the WP-C-04 allocation on each element. E-01: 17 FSRs, highest C, serving SG-01, SG-02, SG-03, SG-04, SG-05, SG-06, SG-07; QM element carrying ASIL FSRs. E-01/DM: 5 FSRs, highest A, serving SG-02, SG-04, SG-06, SG-08; QM element carrying ASIL FSRs. E-01/HMI: 5 FSRs, highest C, serving SG-02, SG-05, SG-06, SG-07, SG-08; QM element carrying ASIL FSRs. E-02: 1 FSRs, highest A, serving SG-02, SG-06, SG-08; QM element carrying ASIL FSRs. E-03: 42 FSRs, highest C, serving SG-01, SG-02, SG-03, SG-04, SG-05, SG-06, SG-07. E-05: 3 FSRs, highest C, serving SG-01, SG-03, SG-07. EXT-EPS: 1 FSRs, highest ext, serving SG-01, SG-05. EXT-PCM: 4 FSRs, highest B, serving SG-03, SG-04, SG-05, SG-07. EXT-CLU: 1 FSRs, highest C, serving SG-02, SG-05, SG-06. Driver: no FSR, assumptions AOU-06R, AOU-02R.
